summary: ZombiU entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: ZombiU
entries.definitive_edition: Original Wii U release, with Zombi port documented separately if compared

emulation.emulator: Cemu only for comparison if GamePad features are accurately mapped
emulation.notes: Native Wii U hardware is preferred for primary.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Wii U hardware with GamePad/capture setup documented

primary.why: ZombiU was designed around the Wii U GamePad, including inventory, scanning, speaker, and local multiplayer features. The later Zombi PC/PS4/Xbox One port is easier to capture but removes or changes important Wii U-specific systems.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original Wii U release for fidelity. Record hardware, GamePad state, controller/speaker/scanner use, difficulty, survivor/permadeath state, multiplayer state, Miiverse/online limitations, and whether Zombi PC/console port was compared.

secondary.platform: Zombi on Windows PC / PlayStation 4 / Xbox One
secondary.why: It is not the full Wii U design route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Zombi is a port, not a full replacement for the GamePad-based ZombiU route.
